content.text: Digital creators in the Philippines face significant barriers when it comes to payment processing. Major platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable, leaving creators unable to monetize their work effectively. This limitation creates an urgent need for robust, sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] that eliminates dependency on these conventional systems. The Edge Commerce Stack offers a solution that combines Google Apps Script with powerful tools to automate digital commerce seamlessly, providing a reliable pathway for creators to sell their products online. By [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-plain-language-16|Understanding Selling]]-kyc-payment-gateways-digital-sellers-plain-language-18|understanding]] the underlying architecture of Google Apps Script, creators can leverage this technology to build a sustainable income stream without the constraints imposed by traditional payment platforms.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Without traditional payment platforms, creators can feel isolated. Google Apps Script provides a pathway to reclaim that agency. It allows creators to configure their online stores to operate independently. With Google Apps Script, tasks such as sending confirmation emails or managing inventory can be automated, making operations efficient and user-friendly. This level of automation isn’t just a convenience; it’s a necessity for creators looking to optimize their time and revenue. The Edge Commerce Stack integrates these capabilities, offering a complete solution that includes payment processing and the fulfillment of digital products, all while ensuring that creators retain full ownership of their sales infrastructure.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is built on free or low-cost components, ensuring that creators in resource-constrained environments can deploy it without financial strain. The combination of Google Apps Script and Cloudflare Workers provides a robust infrastructure that automates tedious tasks, eliminating the need for manual intervention. Each component communicates smoothly, with Google Apps Script triggering workflows in Cloudflare Workers when a purchase is made or when a product needs to be delivered. This self-contained ecosystem allows creators to manage their digital commerce operations effectively, ensuring that they can focus on creating rather than troubleshooting payment issues.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Digital creators who prioritize ownership and control over their sales channels will find this architecture particularly beneficial. By leveraging Google Apps Script, they can automate complex workflows that enhance customer experience and engagement. Creators can tailor their sales process to meet the needs of their audience, establishing a brand identity that resonates without outside interference. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed to empower these creators, providing them with the infrastructure needed to thrive in a digital economy that is constantly evolving.
Google Apps Script enables powerful automation for your online store.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component interconnects seamlessly, creating a holistic solution for digital commerce automation. Google Apps Script initiates processes based on user actions, such as a purchase or a new order, interacting with the other tools to execute the workflow. Cloudflare Workers respond to these actions by verifying payments, ensuring that funds are secured before triggering delivery of digital products. Supabase or Google Sheets maintains a live record of all transactions, providing creators with real-time access to their sales data. This architecture not only boosts efficiency but also enhances transparency, giving creators full control over their operations.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

After establishing this connection, set up your database using Supabase or Google Sheets to store order information securely. Make sure to define your database structure to capture all relevant data points. Following that, integrate NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency processing. Test your setup thoroughly to ensure each component interacts correctly and that payments are processed seamlessly. Once live, monitor your sales and engage with your customers to refine your offerings. This deployment not only establishes your online presence but also protects your autonomy as a digital creator.

The Edge Commerce Stack utilizes Google Apps Script to automate various aspects of digital commerce, allowing creators to manage orders, communicate with customers, and process payments without relying on Stripe or PayPal. This stack is designed for creators in regions where these services are unavailable, offering full control and ownership of their sales infrastructure. Deploying this architecture enables creators to build sustainable online businesses that operate independently.
The Edge Commerce Stack empowers creators with full ownership.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Edge Commerce Stack simplifies the process of setting up a sovereign online store. It combines various free and powerful tools, making it accessible for digital creators in the Philippines and beyond. With a straightforward setup, this stack ensures that creators can focus on their craft without being hindered by traditional payment barriers.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Sign up for a Google account to access Google Apps Script and Google Sheets. 2. Create a Cloudflare account and set up Cloudflare Workers for your backend logic. 3. Register for a NOWPayments account to enable cryptocurrency transactions. 4. Design your order management script in Google Apps Script, using provided templates to streamline the process. 5. Configure your database in Supabase or Google Sheets to capture order details effectively. 6. Integrate NOWPayments into your workflow to process payments securely and efficiently. 7. Test your entire system to ensure all components function together seamlessly before going live.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Google Apps Script?

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting language that allows users to automate tasks and extend the functionality of Google Workspace applications. Its flexibility makes it ideal for managing digital commerce processes.
What does the Edge Commerce Stack include?

The Edge Commerce Stack includes Google Apps Script for automation, Cloudflare Workers for executing logic, and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions, enabling a fully operational online store.
How does this solution improve my sales process?
This architecture automates key sales processes, such as order management and communication, ensuring efficiency and allowing you to focus on creating instead of troubleshooting payment issues.
Can I customize my store with this stack?
Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack is designed to be customizable. You can tailor your Google Apps Script and Cloudflare Workers to fit your unique business needs and brand identity.
Is there support available for setup?
Yes, purchasing the Edge Commerce Stack includes access to support, which can assist in configuring your system and troubleshooting any issues during deployment.
